notes: TMax is rich here (multi-format ETL with schema unification is a recurring TMax genre) and takes 7 of the final 10. Two useful cross-corpus finds the retrievers missed: fvcore's multiple-base-config merge with precedence (SWE-Smith) is the best non-TMax match for the source-priority rule, and vaex-402 (SWE-Rebench) is the best match for outer-join-with-keys-missing-on-either-side. RTS's shortlist was dominated by unrelated Slack-cookie and git-audit tasks; the useful RTS material (extra-object union with conflict resolution, key-value file joins, config precedence merges) came only from my own searches. TerminalWorld is thin on Parquet (2 instructions corpus-wide) and pandas (3), so its ranks 7-10 score 2. 'conflict' matches 525 instructions, mostly Docker-package and git-merge boilerplate - ignored.
